policy.budgets: Ceilings here bound what a job may request; they are not spending authorization by themselves. On 2026-10-20 the owner approved, in session, up to 5,000 credits ($5) per daily run across paid jobs: daily-refresh up to 1,200 and x4o2-coin-panels up to 3,800. A paid job runs only under an approval supplied with the invocation (the scheduled routine's prompt, or LAMBLE_FRAMES_BUDGET_ID and LAMBLE_FRAMES_BUDGET_USD for the programmatic collector). Without one, paid jobs plan and stop. 5,000 credits a day is about 150,000 a month, above the 90,000 monthly grant: purchased credits are needed before the grant runs out.
policy.schedules: scheduleStatus says what is actually running: active-external (installed outside this repository and observed through its commits), configured (cron and runbook ready, nothing installed), manual (run by an operator). No job in this repository installs a scheduler.
policy.writers: Jobs with the same writerGroup take the same lock (scripts/lamble/lock.ts); daily and weekly writers never overlap.
policy.serving: Page views, builds and API reads never run a job and never make a paid call.

codexBars.ohlcStatus: Field names verified against the retained official getTokenBars example (research/lamble/20260926T170103Z/raw/codex-gettokenbars.md lines 113-120); not yet seen in a live Frames response. The same paid calls carry them (no extra calls). If the first run's c1 or c2 returns GraphQL errors naming these fields, set ohlcEnabled to false, re-run plan.py collect and retry the bars as the next c batch.

jobs.description: Load every successful research run into the observation store (idempotent, revision-preserving).
Compute holder analysis, signals, narratives, launchpads and market views from the store; stage, validate, publish atomically; write changes.
Freeze the latest complete calendar week (Monday 00:00 UTC to Monday 00:00 UTC, end exclusive) once its completeness checks pass; write a new revision for corrections.
jobs.scope: Calendar week and its comparison week.

jobs.description: Derive structured findings from a release, render drafts, validate every claim against release evidence. Interpretive drafts wait for review (docs/runbooks/editorial-policy.md).

jobs.description: Deliver change events to verified, consented webhook or Telegram destinations with deduplication and retries.

framesPricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd x 1.15 + $0.005; refunded calls bill $0; max_usd must cover the sum (frames_get_usage, 2026-10-20).
framesPricing.accountLimits: Plan per-run allowance 10,000 credits ($10); monthly grant 90,000 credits (frames_get_usage, 2026-10-20).
